```python
import os
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import TwoSlopeNorm

import scanpy as sc

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# User settings

OUTDIR = Path("milo_hippo_umap_plots")
OUTDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

MILO_RESULTS_CSV = "pertpy_milo_hippo_DA/combined_milo_neighborhood_DA_results.csv"

HIPPO_TARGETS = ["NF2", "LATS2", "SAV1", "TAOK1", "AMOTL2"]

# Plot these modes/days.
# Usually all_carriers is first; low_guide_load_leq2 is useful robustness.
MODES_TO_PLOT = ["all_carriers", "low_guide_load_leq2", "single_selected_target"]
DAYS_TO_PLOT = ["d1", "d2", "d3"]

# Significance threshold for outlining neighborhoods.
FDR_CUTOFF = 0.10

# Color scale for Milo logFC.
# Positive = Hippo target carrier enriched over non-targeting control.
LOGFC_CLIP = 3.0

# Background UMAP plotting.
BACKGROUND_POINT_SIZE = 1.0
BACKGROUND_ALPHA = 0.12

# Neighborhood point plotting.
NHOOD_POINT_SIZE = 22
NHOOD_ALPHA = 0.90

# Use this if your results have UMAP neighborhood center columns:
#   X_umap_mean1, X_umap_mean2
# If missing, see fallback section below.
UMAP_KEY = "X_umap"

# Optional: color background by day/cell_type instead of plain grey?
BACKGROUND_COLOR_BY = None
# Examples:
# BACKGROUND_COLOR_BY = "cell_type"
# BACKGROUND_COLOR_BY = "day"
```

```python
def _get_background_df(adata, day=None, max_cells=60000, random_seed=1):
    """
    Return a sampled background UMAP dataframe.
    If day is provided, restrict background to that day.
    """
    obs = adata.obs.copy()

    if day is not None and "day_clean" in obs.columns:
        obs = obs[obs["day_clean"].astype(str).str.lower().eq(str(day).lower())].copy()

    if len(obs) > max_cells:
        obs = obs.sample(max_cells, random_state=random_seed)

    return obs


def _plot_background(ax, bg_df):
    """
    Plot grey or optionally colored background cells.
    """
    if BACKGROUND_COLOR_BY is None or BACKGROUND_COLOR_BY not in bg_df.columns:
        ax.scatter(
            bg_df["UMAP1"],
            bg_df["UMAP2"],
            s=BACKGROUND_POINT_SIZE,
            c="lightgrey",
            alpha=BACKGROUND_ALPHA,
            linewidths=0,
            rasterized=True,
        )
    else:
        # Simple categorical coloring for background, low alpha.
        cats = pd.Categorical(bg_df[BACKGROUND_COLOR_BY])
        codes = cats.codes
        ax.scatter(
            bg_df["UMAP1"],
            bg_df["UMAP2"],
            s=BACKGROUND_POINT_SIZE,
            c=codes,
            alpha=BACKGROUND_ALPHA,
            linewidths=0,
            rasterized=True,
        )


def _prepare_nhood_df(milo_res, target, day, mode):
    sub = milo_res[
        milo_res["target"].astype(str).eq(str(target))
        & milo_res["day"].astype(str).str.lower().eq(str(day).lower())
        & milo_res["mode"].astype(str).eq(str(mode))
    ].copy()

    if len(sub) == 0:
        return sub

    if {"X_umap_mean1", "X_umap_mean2"}.issubset(sub.columns):
        sub["plot_x"] = sub["X_umap_mean1"]
        sub["plot_y"] = sub["X_umap_mean2"]
        sub["coordinate_type"] = "UMAP neighborhood center"
    elif {"mean_umap1", "mean_umap2"}.issubset(sub.columns):
        sub["plot_x"] = sub["mean_umap1"]
        sub["plot_y"] = sub["mean_umap2"]
        sub["coordinate_type"] = "UMAP neighborhood center"
    else:
        raise KeyError(
            "Milo results do not contain UMAP neighborhood center columns. "
            "Need X_umap_mean1/X_umap_mean2. See fallback Cell 7."
        )

    sub["logFC_capped"] = sub["logFC"].clip(-LOGFC_CLIP, LOGFC_CLIP)
    sub["sig"] = sub["SpatialFDR"] < FDR_CUTOFF
    sub["minus_log10_fdr"] = -np.log10(sub["SpatialFDR"].clip(lower=1e-300))

    return sub


def plot_milo_umap_one_panel(
    adata,
    milo_res,
    target,
    day,
    mode="all_carriers",
    ax=None,
    title=None,
    show_colorbar=True,
):
    """
    Plot one target/day/mode panel:
      background = cells in adata UMAP
      overlay = Milo neighborhood centers colored by logFC
      black outline = significant neighborhoods
    """
    sub = _prepare_nhood_df(milo_res, target=target, day=day, mode=mode)

    if ax is None:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
    else:
        fig = ax.figure

    bg_df = _get_background_df(adata, day=day)
    _plot_background(ax, bg_df)

    if len(sub) == 0:
        ax.set_title(f"{target} {day} {mode}\nno Milo results", fontsize=11)
        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.set_yticks([])
        return ax

    norm = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-LOGFC_CLIP, vcenter=0, vmax=LOGFC_CLIP)

    sc_main = ax.scatter(
        sub["plot_x"],
        sub["plot_y"],
        c=sub["logFC_capped"],
        cmap="RdBu_r",
        norm=norm,
        s=NHOOD_POINT_SIZE,
        alpha=NHOOD_ALPHA,
        linewidths=0,
        rasterized=True,
    )

    # Significant neighborhoods: black ring.
    sig = sub[sub["sig"]].copy()
    if len(sig):
        ax.scatter(
            sig["plot_x"],
            sig["plot_y"],
            s=NHOOD_POINT_SIZE * 1.8,
            facecolors="none",
            edgecolors="black",
            linewidths=0.8,
            alpha=0.95,
        )

    n_sig = int(sub["sig"].sum())
    n_pos_sig = int(((sub["sig"]) & (sub["logFC"] > 0)).sum())
    n_neg_sig = int(((sub["sig"]) & (sub["logFC"] < 0)).sum())

    if title is None:
        title = (
            f"{target} | {day} | {mode}\n"
            f"FDR<{FDR_CUTOFF}: {n_sig} "
            f"(+{n_pos_sig}/−{n_neg_sig})"
        )

    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel("UMAP1")
    ax.set_ylabel("UMAP2")
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")

    if show_colorbar:
        cbar = fig.colorbar(sc_main, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.02)
        cbar.set_label("Milo logFC\nTarget vs NT", fontsize=9)

    return ax
```

## Code cell 79

```python
def plot_milo_umap_for_gene(
    adata,
    milo_res,
    target,
    mode="all_carriers",
    days=DAYS_TO_PLOT,
    outdir=OUTDIR,
):
    """
    Makes a multi-panel UMAP for one Hippo target across days.
    """
    days_available = [
        d for d in days
        if len(
            milo_res[
                milo_res["target"].astype(str).eq(str(target))
                & milo_res["day"].astype(str).str.lower().eq(str(d).lower())
                & milo_res["mode"].astype(str).eq(str(mode))
            ]
        ) > 0
    ]

    if len(days_available) == 0:
        print(f"No Milo results for {target}, mode={mode}")
        return None

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        len(days_available),
        figsize=(5.2 * len(days_available), 4.8),
        squeeze=False,
    )

    for i, day in enumerate(days_available):
        ax = axes[0, i]
        plot_milo_umap_one_panel(
            adata=adata,
            milo_res=milo_res,
            target=target,
            day=day,
            mode=mode,
            ax=ax,
            show_colorbar=(i == len(days_available) - 1),
        )

    fig.suptitle(
        f"Milo neighborhood enrichment on UMAP: {target} ({mode})",
        fontsize=13,
        fontweight="bold",
    )

    fig.tight_layout()

    out_png = Path(outdir) / f"Milo_UMAP_{target}_{mode}.png"
    out_pdf = Path(outdir) / f"Milo_UMAP_{target}_{mode}.pdf"

    fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(out_pdf, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()

    print("Saved:", out_png)
    return fig


for target in HIPPO_TARGETS:
    plot_milo_umap_for_gene(
        adata=adata,
        milo_res=milo_res,
        target=target,
        mode="all_carriers",
    )
```

```python
def plot_milo_umap_grid(
    adata,
    milo_res,
    targets=HIPPO_TARGETS,
    days=DAYS_TO_PLOT,
    mode="all_carriers",
    outdir=OUTDIR,
):
    targets_available = [
        t for t in targets
        if len(milo_res[milo_res["target"].astype(str).eq(str(t))]) > 0
    ]

    n_rows = len(targets_available)
    n_cols = len(days)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        n_rows,
        n_cols,
        figsize=(4.4 * n_cols, 4.0 * n_rows),
        squeeze=False,
    )

    for r, target in enumerate(targets_available):
        for c, day in enumerate(days):
            ax = axes[r, c]

            has_data = len(
                milo_res[
                    milo_res["target"].astype(str).eq(str(target))
                    & milo_res["day"].astype(str).str.lower().eq(str(day).lower())
                    & milo_res["mode"].astype(str).eq(str(mode))
                ]
            ) > 0

            if has_data:
                plot_milo_umap_one_panel(
                    adata=adata,
                    milo_res=milo_res,
                    target=target,
                    day=day,
                    mode=mode,
                    ax=ax,
                    title=f"{target} | {day}",
                    show_colorbar=False,
                )
            else:
                bg_df = _get_background_df(adata, day=day)
                _plot_background(ax, bg_df)
                ax.set_title(f"{target} | {day}\nno result", fontsize=10)
                ax.set_xticks([])
                ax.set_yticks([])
                ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")

    # Shared colorbar.
    norm = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-LOGFC_CLIP, vcenter=0, vmax=LOGFC_CLIP)
    sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap="RdBu_r", norm=norm)
    sm.set_array([])

    cbar = fig.colorbar(
        sm,
        ax=axes.ravel().tolist(),
        fraction=0.025,
        pad=0.01,
    )
    cbar.set_label("Milo logFC\nTarget vs NT", fontsize=10)

    fig.suptitle(
        f"Milo neighborhood enrichment on UMAP ({mode})",
        fontsize=15,
        fontweight="bold",
    )

    out_png = Path(outdir) / f"Milo_UMAP_grid_{mode}.png"
    out_pdf = Path(outdir) / f"Milo_UMAP_grid_{mode}.pdf"

    fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(out_pdf, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()

    print("Saved:", out_png)
    return fig


plot_milo_umap_grid(
    adata=adata,
    milo_res=milo_res,
    targets=HIPPO_TARGETS,
    days=["d1", "d2", "d3"],
    mode="all_carriers",
)
```

```python
# ============================================================
# Helper: choose neighborhood coordinates
# ============================================================

def prepare_milo_for_umap(milo_res):
    """
    Adds plot_x / plot_y columns for neighborhood centers.

    Preferred:
        X_umap_mean1 / X_umap_mean2

    Fallback:
        mean_umap1 / mean_umap2

    If neither exists, this raises an error.
    """
    df = milo_res.copy()

    if {"X_umap_mean1", "X_umap_mean2"}.issubset(df.columns):
        df["plot_x"] = df["X_umap_mean1"]
        df["plot_y"] = df["X_umap_mean2"]
        df["coordinate_type"] = "UMAP neighborhood center"

    elif {"mean_umap1", "mean_umap2"}.issubset(df.columns):
        df["plot_x"] = df["mean_umap1"]
        df["plot_y"] = df["mean_umap2"]
        df["coordinate_type"] = "UMAP neighborhood center"

    else:
        raise KeyError(
            "Milo results do not contain UMAP neighborhood centers. "
            "Expected X_umap_mean1/X_umap_mean2. "
            "Rerun the Milo script with UMAP center export or saved h5mu objects."
        )

    df["logFC_capped"] = df["logFC"].clip(-LOGFC_CLIP, LOGFC_CLIP)
    df["sig"] = df["SpatialFDR"] < FDR_CUTOFF
    df["minus_log10_fdr"] = -np.log10(df["SpatialFDR"].clip(lower=1e-300))

    return df


milo_plot = prepare_milo_for_umap(milo_res)
```

```python
# ============================================================
# Plot one UMAP per Hippo gene, all days pooled
# ============================================================

def plot_one_gene_all_days(
    adata,
    milo_plot,
    target,
    mode=MODE_TO_PLOT,
    outdir=OUTDIR,
):
    sub = milo_plot[
        milo_plot["target"].astype(str).eq(str(target))
        & milo_plot["mode"].astype(str).eq(str(mode))
    ].copy()

    if len(sub) == 0:
        print(f"No Milo results for {target}, mode={mode}")
        return None

    # Background = all cells, all days
    bg = adata.obs[["UMAP1", "UMAP2", "day_clean"]].copy()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.8, 6.2))

    ax.scatter(
        bg["UMAP1"],
        bg["UMAP2"],
        s=BACKGROUND_POINT_SIZE,
        c="lightgrey",
        alpha=BACKGROUND_ALPHA,
        linewidths=0,
        rasterized=True,
    )

    norm = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-LOGFC_CLIP, vcenter=0, vmax=LOGFC_CLIP)

    # Plot neighborhoods by day using different markers, but same logFC color scale
    for day in sorted(sub["day"].dropna().astype(str).unique()):
        d = sub[sub["day"].astype(str).eq(day)].copy()
        marker = DAY_MARKERS.get(day, "o")

        sc = ax.scatter(
            d["plot_x"],
            d["plot_y"],
            c=d["logFC_capped"],
            cmap="RdBu_r",
            norm=norm,
            s=NHOOD_POINT_SIZE,
            alpha=NHOOD_ALPHA,
            marker=marker,
            linewidths=0,
            label=day,
        )

        # Significant neighborhoods: black outline
        sig = d[d["sig"]].copy()
        if len(sig):
            ax.scatter(
                sig["plot_x"],
                sig["plot_y"],
                s=NHOOD_POINT_SIZE * 1.9,
                facecolors="none",
                edgecolors="black",
                linewidths=0.9,
                marker=marker,
            )

    n_total = len(sub)
    n_sig = int(sub["sig"].sum())
    n_pos_sig = int(((sub["sig"]) & (sub["logFC"] > 0)).sum())
    n_neg_sig = int(((sub["sig"]) & (sub["logFC"] < 0)).sum())

    ax.set_title(
        f"{target} Milo neighborhood enrichment\n"
        f"{mode}; all days pooled | FDR<{FDR_CUTOFF}: {n_sig} "
        f"(+{n_pos_sig}/−{n_neg_sig})",
        fontsize=12,
        fontweight="bold",
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("UMAP1")
    ax.set_ylabel("UMAP2")
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")

    # Day marker legend
    leg = ax.legend(
        title="Milo run day",
        loc="upper right",
        frameon=True,
        fontsize=9,
        title_fontsize=10,
    )
    leg.get_frame().set_linewidth(0.5)

    # logFC colorbar
    cbar = fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.02)
    cbar.set_label("Milo logFC\nTarget vs NT", fontsize=10)

    fig.tight_layout()

    out_png = Path(outdir) / f"Milo_UMAP_all_days_{target}_{mode}.png"
    out_pdf = Path(outdir) / f"Milo_UMAP_all_days_{target}_{mode}.pdf"

    fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(out_pdf, bbox_inches="tight")

    plt.show()

    print("Saved:", out_png)

    return fig


for target in HIPPO_TARGETS:
    plot_one_gene_all_days(
        adata=adata,
        milo_plot=milo_plot,
        target=target,
        mode=MODE_TO_PLOT,
    )
```

## Code cell 92

```python
def looks_nt(x):
    s = str(x).lower()

    patterns = [
        "non-target", "nontarget", "non_target", "non targeting",
        "negative", "control", "scramble", "scrambled", "safe", "ntc"
    ]

    return any(p in s for p in patterns) or s in {"nt", "neg", "ctrl"}


def parse_target_from_guide(guide):
    g = str(guide)

    if looks_nt(g):
        return CONTROL_TARGET

    for sep in ["|", ":", "_", "-", ".", " "]:
        if sep in g:
            first = g.split(sep)[0]
            if first:
                return first

    return g


def infer_col(df, candidates):
    lower = {str(c).lower(): c for c in df.columns}

    for cand in candidates:
        if cand.lower() in lower:
            return lower[cand.lower()]

    for col in df.columns:
        cl = str(col).lower()
        for cand in candidates:
            if cand.lower() in cl:
                return col

    return None


def get_guide_names(adata, guide_assignment_key=GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_KEY):
    ga = adata.obsm[guide_assignment_key]

    if isinstance(ga, pd.DataFrame):
        return np.asarray(ga.columns.astype(str))

    if "guide_names" in adata.uns:
        return np.asarray(adata.uns["guide_names"]).astype(str)

    raise KeyError(
        "Could not find guide names. Expected adata.uns['guide_names'] "
        "or DataFrame columns in adata.obsm['guide_assignment']."
    )


def get_guide_assignment_df(adata, guide_assignment_key=GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_KEY):
    ga = adata.obsm[guide_assignment_key]
    guide_names = get_guide_names(adata, guide_assignment_key)

    if isinstance(ga, pd.DataFrame):
        out = ga.copy()
        out.index = adata.obs_names
        out.columns = out.columns.astype(str)
        return out.astype(bool)

    if sparse.issparse(ga):
        ga = ga.toarray()

    ga = np.asarray(ga)

    return pd.DataFrame(
        ga,
        index=adata.obs_names,
        columns=guide_names,
    ).astype(bool)


def build_guide_target_table(
    adata,
    guide_target_csv=GUIDE_TARGET_CSV,
    guide_assignment_key=GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_KEY,
):
    guide_names = pd.Index(
        get_guide_names(adata, guide_assignment_key),
        name="guide",
    ).astype(str)

    base = pd.DataFrame({"guide": guide_names})

    if guide_target_csv is not None and os.path.exists(guide_target_csv):
        gt = pd.read_csv(guide_target_csv)

        guide_col = infer_col(
            gt,
            ["guide", "guide_name", "sgRNA", "sgrna", "gRNA", "oligo", "spacer"],
        )
        target_col = infer_col(
            gt,
            ["target", "target_name", "target_gene", "gene", "symbol", "Target", "TargetGene"],
        )

        if guide_col is None or target_col is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Could not infer guide/target columns in {guide_target_csv}. "
                f"Columns: {list(gt.columns)}"
            )

        gt = gt[[guide_col, target_col]].copy()
        gt.columns = ["guide", "target"]
        gt["guide"] = gt["guide"].astype(str)
        gt["target"] = gt["target"].astype(str)

        out = base.merge(gt, on="guide", how="left")
        out["target"] = out["target"].fillna(out["guide"].map(parse_target_from_guide))
    else:
        out = base.copy()
        out["target"] = out["guide"].map(parse_target_from_guide)

    out["is_non_targeting"] = out["guide"].map(looks_nt) | out["target"].map(looks_nt)
    out.loc[out["is_non_targeting"], "target"] = CONTROL_TARGET

    return out


def get_target_assignment_df(guide_assignment, guide_target):
    """
    Efficient cell x target boolean matrix.
    """
    guide_assignment = guide_assignment.astype(bool)

    gt = guide_target[["guide", "target"]].copy()
    gt["guide"] = gt["guide"].astype(str)
    gt["target"] = gt["target"].astype(str)
    gt = gt[gt["guide"].isin(guide_assignment.columns)].copy()

    series_by_target = {}

    for target, sub in gt.groupby("target", sort=True):
        guides = sub["guide"].tolist()

        if len(guides) == 1:
            series_by_target[target] = guide_assignment[guides[0]].astype(bool)
        else:
            series_by_target[target] = guide_assignment.loc[:, guides].any(axis=1)

    out = pd.DataFrame(series_by_target, index=guide_assignment.index)

    return out.astype(bool).copy()


def bh_fdr(pvals):
    p = np.asarray(pvals, dtype=float)
    q = np.full_like(p, np.nan, dtype=float)

    mask = np.isfinite(p)
    if mask.sum() == 0:
        return q

    x = p[mask]
    order = np.argsort(x)
    ranked = x[order]
    n = len(ranked)

    adj = ranked * n / np.arange(1, n + 1)
    adj = np.minimum.accumulate(adj[::-1])[::-1]
    adj = np.clip(adj, 0, 1)

    q_sub = np.empty_like(adj)
    q_sub[order] = adj

    q[mask] = q_sub

    return q
```

## Code cell 93

```python
def standardize_program_col(c):
    s = str(c)

    if s.startswith("Program "):
        return f"Program {int(s.replace('Program ', ''))}"

    if s.startswith("P"):
        return f"Program {int(s.replace('P', ''))}"

    return f"Program {int(float(s))}"


def get_cnmf_usage_df(
    adata,
    cnmf_key=CNMF_KEY,
    array_program_index_base=CNMF_ARRAY_PROGRAM_INDEX_BASE,
):
    """
    Return cell x cNMF-program usage dataframe.
    """
    if cnmf_key not in adata.obsm:
        raise KeyError(f"adata.obsm['{cnmf_key}'] not found.")

    X = adata.obsm[cnmf_key]

    if isinstance(X, pd.DataFrame):
        df = X.copy()
        df.index = adata.obs_names
        df.columns = [standardize_program_col(c) for c in df.columns]

        if pd.Index(df.columns).duplicated().any():
            print("[warning] Duplicate cNMF program columns; collapsing duplicates by mean.")
            df = df.T.groupby(level=0).mean().T

        return df.astype(float)

    if sparse.issparse(X):
        X = X.toarray()

    X = np.asarray(X)

    cols = [
        f"Program {i + array_program_index_base}"
        for i in range(X.shape[1])
    ]

    return pd.DataFrame(
        X,
        index=adata.obs_names,
        columns=cols,
    ).astype(float)


def transform_cnmf_for_knn(cnmf_df, transform=CNMF_TRANSFORM):
    """
    Transform cNMF usage matrix for kNN.
    """
    X = cnmf_df.values.astype(float)

    if transform == "raw":
        X2 = X.copy()

    elif transform == "zscore":
        mu = np.nanmean(X, axis=0)
        sd = np.nanstd(X, axis=0)
        sd[sd == 0] = 1.0
        X2 = (X - mu) / sd

    elif transform == "clr_zscore":
        eps = 1e-8
        logX = np.log(X + eps)
        clr = logX - np.nanmean(logX, axis=1, keepdims=True)

        mu = np.nanmean(clr, axis=0)
        sd = np.nanstd(clr, axis=0)
        sd[sd == 0] = 1.0

        X2 = (clr - mu) / sd

    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown CNMF_TRANSFORM: {transform}")

    X2 = np.nan_to_num(X2, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

    return X2


def select_cnmf_programs(cnmf_df, programs=PROGRAMS_FOR_KNN):
    """
    If programs is None, use all cNMF programs.
    If list is provided, use only those programs.
    """
    if programs is None:
        return cnmf_df.copy()

    cols = []
    for p in programs:
        if isinstance(p, str):
            col = p if p.startswith("Program ") else standardize_program_col(p)
        else:
            col = f"Program {int(p)}"

        if col not in cnmf_df.columns:
            raise KeyError(f"Requested {col}, but it is not in cNMF usage columns.")

        cols.append(col)

    return cnmf_df[cols].copy()
```

```python
def get_mode_masks(target):
    """
    Returns:
      seed_mask_base: cells eligible as seed target carriers
      nt_mask_base: cells eligible as non-targeting controls
    """
    target_mask = target_assignment[target].values
    nt_mask = target_assignment[CONTROL_TARGET].values

    n_total_guides = adata.obs["n_total_guides"].values
    n_targeting_targets = adata.obs["n_targeting_targets"].values

    if MODE == "all_carriers":
        seed_mask_base = target_mask
        nt_mask_base = nt_mask & (~target_mask)

    elif MODE == "low_guide_load_leq2":
        low = n_total_guides <= 2
        seed_mask_base = target_mask & low
        nt_mask_base = nt_mask & (~target_mask) & low

    elif MODE == "single_selected_target":
        seed_mask_base = target_mask & (n_targeting_targets == 1)
        nt_mask_base = nt_mask & (~target_mask) & (n_targeting_targets == 0)

    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown MODE: {MODE}")

    return seed_mask_base, nt_mask_base
```

## Code cell 96

```python
def compute_carrier_seeded_cnmf_knn_enrichment_multiK(
    target,
    k_values=K_VALUES,
    restrict_neighbors_to_same_day=RESTRICT_NEIGHBORS_TO_SAME_DAY,
    same_day_baseline=SAME_DAY_BASELINE,
    pseudocount=0.5,
):
    """
    For each carrier seed cell of one target:
      1. Find max(K_VALUES) nearest neighbors in cNMF space.
      2. Exclude the seed cell itself.
      3. For each k, use the first k neighbors.
      4. Count local target carriers and NT controls.
      5. Compare local target/NT ratio to same-day/global background ratio.
      6. Compute Fisher p-value and FDR.

    Returns one row per seed cell per k.
    """
    if target not in target_assignment.columns:
        print(f"[skip] {target}: target not found.")
        return pd.DataFrame()

    k_values = sorted([int(k) for k in k_values])
    max_k = max(k_values)

    seed_mask_base, nt_mask_base = get_mode_masks(target)

    day_vec = adata.obs["day_clean"].astype(str).values
    obs_names = np.asarray(adata.obs_names)

    seed_idx_all = np.where(seed_mask_base)[0]

    if len(seed_idx_all) == 0:
        print(f"[skip] {target}: no seed cells in mode {MODE}.")
        return pd.DataFrame()

    rows = []

    # Build KNN either globally or separately per day.
    if restrict_neighbors_to_same_day:
        groups = sorted(pd.unique(day_vec[seed_idx_all]))
    else:
        groups = ["all"]

    for group in groups:
        if restrict_neighbors_to_same_day:
            candidate_mask = day_vec == group
            seed_idx = seed_idx_all[day_vec[seed_idx_all] == group]
        else:
            candidate_mask = np.ones(adata.n_obs, dtype=bool)
            seed_idx = seed_idx_all

        candidate_idx = np.where(candidate_mask)[0]

        if len(candidate_idx) <= 2 or len(seed_idx) == 0:
            continue

        X_candidate = X_cnmf_knn[candidate_idx, :]

        n_neighbors = min(max_k + 1, len(candidate_idx))

        nbrs = NearestNeighbors(
            n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
            metric="euclidean",
        )

        nbrs.fit(X_candidate)

        global_to_local = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(candidate_idx)}
        seed_local = np.array([global_to_local[s] for s in seed_idx])

        nn_local = nbrs.kneighbors(
            X_candidate[seed_local, :],
            return_distance=False,
        )

        for s_global, neigh_local in zip(seed_idx, nn_local):
            neigh_global_all = candidate_idx[neigh_local]

            # Exclude the seed cell itself
            neigh_global_all = neigh_global_all[neigh_global_all != s_global]

            seed_day = day_vec[s_global]

            if same_day_baseline:
                base_mask = day_vec == seed_day
            else:
                base_mask = np.ones(adata.n_obs, dtype=bool)

            target_base_mask = seed_mask_base & base_mask
            nt_base_mask = nt_mask_base & base_mask

            # Background counts excluding the seed itself.
            A = int(target_base_mask.sum()) - 1
            B = int(nt_base_mask.sum())

            A = max(A, 0)

            for k in k_values:
                neigh_global = neigh_global_all[:min(k, len(neigh_global_all))]

                # Local counts excluding seed
                a = int(seed_mask_base[neigh_global].sum())
                b = int(nt_mask_base[neigh_global].sum())

                A_out = max(A - a, 0)
                B_out = max(B - b, 0)

                if B == 0 or (a + b) == 0:
                    log2fc = np.nan
                    fisher_p = np.nan
                else:
                    local_ratio = (a + pseudocount) / (b + pseudocount)
                    background_ratio = (A + pseudocount) / (B + pseudocount)

                    log2fc = np.log2(local_ratio / background_ratio)

                    try:
                        fisher_p = fisher_exact(
                            [[a, b], [A_out, B_out]],
                            alternative="two-sided",
                        )[1]
                    except Exception:
                        fisher_p = np.nan

                rows.append({
                    "target": target,
                    "mode": MODE,
                    "k": k,
                    "cell_id": obs_names[s_global],
                    "cell_index": int(s_global),
                    "day": seed_day,
                    "cell_type": adata.obs["cell_type_clean"].iloc[s_global],
                    "UMAP1": adata.obs["UMAP1"].iloc[s_global],
                    "UMAP2": adata.obs["UMAP2"].iloc[s_global],
                    "n_neighbors_available": len(neigh_global),
                    "local_target_n": a,
                    "local_nt_n": b,
                    "local_other_n": int(len(neigh_global) - a - b),
                    "background_target_n": A,
                    "background_nt_n": B,
                    "log2_enrichment_target_vs_nt": log2fc,
                    "fisher_p": fisher_p,
                    "restrict_neighbors_to_same_day": restrict_neighbors_to_same_day,
                    "same_day_baseline": same_day_baseline,
                    "knn_space": "cNMF",
                    "cnmf_transform": CNMF_TRANSFORM,
                    "n_cnmf_programs_used": cnmf_df.shape[1],
                })

    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if len(out):
        out["fisher_fdr_by_target_k_day"] = np.nan
        out["fisher_fdr_by_target_k_global"] = np.nan

        # FDR per target/k/day
        for (tg, k, day), idx in out.groupby(["target", "k", "day"]).groups.items():
            out.loc[idx, "fisher_fdr_by_target_k_day"] = bh_fdr(out.loc[idx, "fisher_p"].values)

        # FDR per target/k globally
        for (tg, k), idx in out.groupby(["target", "k"]).groups.items():
            out.loc[idx, "fisher_fdr_by_target_k_global"] = bh_fdr(out.loc[idx, "fisher_p"].values)

    return out
```

```python
def plot_one_gene_all_k(
    scores,
    target,
    k_values=K_VALUES,
    outdir=OUTDIR,
    fdr_col="fisher_fdr_by_target_k_day",
    fdr_cutoff=FDR_CUTOFF,
    log2fc_clip=LOG2FC_CLIP,
):
    sub_all = scores[scores["target"].eq(target)].copy()

    if len(sub_all) == 0:
        print(f"No scores for {target}.")
        return None

    k_values = [k for k in k_values if k in set(sub_all["k"])]

    if len(k_values) == 0:
        print(f"No requested k values found for {target}.")
        return None

    n_k = len(k_values)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        n_k,
        figsize=(4.8 * n_k, 4.8),
        squeeze=False,
    )

    # Background = all cells, same for every panel
    bg = adata.obs[["UMAP1", "UMAP2", "day_clean"]].copy()

    norm = TwoSlopeNorm(
        vmin=-log2fc_clip,
        vcenter=0,
        vmax=log2fc_clip,
    )

    sc_for_cbar = None

    for i, k in enumerate(k_values):
        ax = axes[0, i]

        sub = sub_all[sub_all["k"].eq(k)].copy()

        ax.scatter(
            bg["UMAP1"],
            bg["UMAP2"],
            s=BACKGROUND_POINT_SIZE,
            c="lightgrey",
            alpha=BACKGROUND_ALPHA,
            linewidths=0,
            rasterized=True,
        )

        sub["log2_capped"] = sub["log2_enrichment_target_vs_nt"].clip(
            -log2fc_clip,
            log2fc_clip,
        )

        sub["is_sig"] = sub[fdr_col] < fdr_cutoff

        nonsig = sub[~sub["is_sig"]].copy()
        sig = sub[sub["is_sig"]].copy()

        # Non-significant carrier cells: faded
        ax.scatter(
            nonsig["UMAP1"],
            nonsig["UMAP2"],
            c=nonsig["log2_capped"],
            cmap="RdBu_r",
            norm=norm,
            s=CARRIER_POINT_SIZE,
            alpha=CARRIER_ALPHA_NONSIG,
            linewidths=0,
            edgecolors="none",
            rasterized=True,
        )

        # Significant carrier cells: same fill scale, stronger alpha
        sc_for_cbar = ax.scatter(
            sig["UMAP1"],
            sig["UMAP2"],
            c=sig["log2_capped"],
            cmap="RdBu_r",
            norm=norm,
            s=CARRIER_POINT_SIZE,
            alpha=CARRIER_ALPHA_SIG,
            linewidths=0,
            edgecolors="none",
            rasterized=True,
        )

        # If no significant cells, use nonsig scatter for colorbar
        if len(sig) == 0:
            sc_for_cbar = ax.scatter(
                nonsig["UMAP1"],
                nonsig["UMAP2"],
                c=nonsig["log2_capped"],
                cmap="RdBu_r",
                norm=norm,
                s=CARRIER_POINT_SIZE,
                alpha=CARRIER_ALPHA_NONSIG,
                linewidths=0,
                edgecolors="none",
                rasterized=True,
            )

        n_cells = len(sub)
        n_sig = int(sub["is_sig"].sum())
        med = sub["log2_enrichment_target_vs_nt"].median()
        frac_pos = np.mean(sub["log2_enrichment_target_vs_nt"] > 0)

        ax.set_title(
            f"\n"
            f"k = {k}, FDR<{fdr_cutoff}: {n_sig}/{n_cells}\n"
            f"median={med:.2f}, +frac={frac_pos:.2f}",
            fontsize=10,
            fontweight="bold",
        )

        ax.set_xlabel("UMAP1")
        if i == 0:
            ax.set_ylabel("UMAP2")
        else:
            ax.set_ylabel("")

        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.set_yticks([])
        ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")

    fig.suptitle(
        f"{target} carrier-seeded cNMF-kNN enrichment across k\n\n",
        fontsize=14,
        fontweight="bold",
    )

    cbar = fig.colorbar(
        sc_for_cbar,
        ax=axes.ravel().tolist(),
        fraction=0.025,
        pad=0.01,
    )

    cbar.set_label(
        "Local enrichment log2FC\nTarget vs NT",
        fontsize=10,
    )

    out_png = outdir / f"carrier_seeded_cnmf_kNN_multiK_UMAP_{target}_{MODE}.png"
    out_pdf = outdir / f"carrier_seeded_cnmf_kNN_multiK_UMAP_{target}_{MODE}.pdf"

    fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(out_pdf, bbox_inches="tight")

    plt.show()

    print("Saved:", out_png)

    return fig
```

```python
import os
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from scipy import sparse
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
from matplotlib.colors import TwoSlopeNorm

import scanpy as sc


# ============================================================
# Settings
# ============================================================

OUTDIR = Path("carrier_seeded_PCA_kNN_enrichment")
OUTDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

HIPPO_TARGETS = ["NF2", "LATS2", "SAV1", "TAOK1", "AMOTL2"]

GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_KEY = "guide_assignment"
GUIDE_TARGET_CSV = "combined_TargetKD.csv"  # set to None if unavailable

DAY_COL = "day"
CELLTYPE_COL = "cell_type"

CONTROL_TARGET = "non-targeting"

# PCA-space neighborhood settings
PCA_KEY = "X_pca"
K = 80

# Recommended to avoid day-composition confounding.
# If True, each seed cell only searches neighbors from the same day.
RESTRICT_NEIGHBORS_TO_SAME_DAY = True

# Recommended: same-day target/NT baseline.
SAME_DAY_BASELINE = True

# Which cells are allowed?
# Options:
#   "all_carriers"
#   "low_guide_load_leq2"
#   "single_selected_target"
MODE = "all_carriers"

# FDR is only used to fade non-significant carrier cells.
FDR_CUTOFF = 0.10

# Plot settings
UMAP_KEY = "X_umap"
LOG2FC_CLIP = 3.0

BACKGROUND_POINT_SIZE = 1.0
BACKGROUND_ALPHA = 0.10

CARRIER_POINT_SIZE = 18
CARRIER_ALPHA_SIG = 0.95
CARRIER_ALPHA_NONSIG = 0.35

RANDOM_SEED = 1
```

## Code cell 107

```python
def looks_nt(x):
    s = str(x).lower()

    patterns = [
        "non-target", "nontarget", "non_target", "non targeting",
        "negative", "control", "scramble", "scrambled", "safe", "ntc"
    ]

    return any(p in s for p in patterns) or s in {"nt", "neg", "ctrl"}


def parse_target_from_guide(guide):
    g = str(guide)

    if looks_nt(g):
        return CONTROL_TARGET

    for sep in ["|", ":", "_", "-", ".", " "]:
        if sep in g:
            first = g.split(sep)[0]
            if first:
                return first

    return g


def infer_col(df, candidates):
    lower = {str(c).lower(): c for c in df.columns}

    for cand in candidates:
        if cand.lower() in lower:
            return lower[cand.lower()]

    for col in df.columns:
        cl = str(col).lower()
        for cand in candidates:
            if cand.lower() in cl:
                return col

    return None


def get_guide_names(adata, guide_assignment_key=GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_KEY):
    ga = adata.obsm[guide_assignment_key]

    if isinstance(ga, pd.DataFrame):
        return np.asarray(ga.columns.astype(str))

    if "guide_names" in adata.uns:
        return np.asarray(adata.uns["guide_names"]).astype(str)

    raise KeyError(
        "Could not find guide names. Expected adata.uns['guide_names'] "
        "or DataFrame columns in adata.obsm['guide_assignment']."
    )


def get_guide_assignment_df(adata, guide_assignment_key=GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_KEY):
    ga = adata.obsm[guide_assignment_key]
    guide_names = get_guide_names(adata, guide_assignment_key)

    if isinstance(ga, pd.DataFrame):
        out = ga.copy()
        out.index = adata.obs_names
        out.columns = out.columns.astype(str)
        return out.astype(bool)

    if sparse.issparse(ga):
        ga = ga.toarray()

    ga = np.asarray(ga)

    return pd.DataFrame(
        ga,
        index=adata.obs_names,
        columns=guide_names,
    ).astype(bool)


def build_guide_target_table(
    adata,
    guide_target_csv=GUIDE_TARGET_CSV,
    guide_assignment_key=GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_KEY,
):
    guide_names = pd.Index(
        get_guide_names(adata, guide_assignment_key),
        name="guide",
    ).astype(str)

    base = pd.DataFrame({"guide": guide_names})

    if guide_target_csv is not None and os.path.exists(guide_target_csv):
        gt = pd.read_csv(guide_target_csv)

        guide_col = infer_col(
            gt,
            ["guide", "guide_name", "sgRNA", "sgrna", "gRNA", "oligo", "spacer"],
        )
        target_col = infer_col(
            gt,
            ["target", "target_name", "target_gene", "gene", "symbol", "Target", "TargetGene"],
        )

        if guide_col is None or target_col is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Could not infer guide/target columns in {guide_target_csv}. "
                f"Columns: {list(gt.columns)}"
            )

        gt = gt[[guide_col, target_col]].copy()
        gt.columns = ["guide", "target"]
        gt["guide"] = gt["guide"].astype(str)
        gt["target"] = gt["target"].astype(str)

        out = base.merge(gt, on="guide", how="left")
        out["target"] = out["target"].fillna(out["guide"].map(parse_target_from_guide))
    else:
        out = base.copy()
        out["target"] = out["guide"].map(parse_target_from_guide)

    out["is_non_targeting"] = out["guide"].map(looks_nt) | out["target"].map(looks_nt)
    out.loc[out["is_non_targeting"], "target"] = CONTROL_TARGET

    return out


def get_target_assignment_df(guide_assignment, guide_target):
    """
    Efficient cell x target boolean matrix.
    """
    guide_assignment = guide_assignment.astype(bool)

    gt = guide_target[["guide", "target"]].copy()
    gt["guide"] = gt["guide"].astype(str)
    gt["target"] = gt["target"].astype(str)
    gt = gt[gt["guide"].isin(guide_assignment.columns)].copy()

    series_by_target = {}

    for target, sub in gt.groupby("target", sort=True):
        guides = sub["guide"].tolist()

        if len(guides) == 1:
            series_by_target[target] = guide_assignment[guides[0]].astype(bool)
        else:
            series_by_target[target] = guide_assignment.loc[:, guides].any(axis=1)

    out = pd.DataFrame(series_by_target, index=guide_assignment.index)

    return out.astype(bool).copy()


def bh_fdr(pvals):
    p = np.asarray(pvals, dtype=float)
    q = np.full_like(p, np.nan, dtype=float)

    mask = np.isfinite(p)
    if mask.sum() == 0:
        return q

    x = p[mask]
    order = np.argsort(x)
    ranked = x[order]
    n = len(ranked)

    adj = ranked * n / np.arange(1, n + 1)
    adj = np.minimum.accumulate(adj[::-1])[::-1]
    adj = np.clip(adj, 0, 1)

    q_sub = np.empty_like(adj)
    q_sub[order] = adj

    q[mask] = q_sub

    return q
```

```python
# ============================================================
# Basic adata setup
# ============================================================

if not adata.obs_names.is_unique:
    adata.obs_names_make_unique()

adata.obs["day_clean"] = adata.obs[DAY_COL].astype(str).str.lower()
adata.obs["cell_type_clean"] = adata.obs[CELLTYPE_COL].astype(str)

# UMAP for plotting
if UMAP_KEY not in adata.obsm:
    raise KeyError(f"adata.obsm['{UMAP_KEY}'] not found. Compute/load UMAP first.")

umap = np.asarray(adata.obsm[UMAP_KEY])
adata.obs["UMAP1"] = umap[:, 0]
adata.obs["UMAP2"] = umap[:, 1]

# PCA for kNN
if PCA_KEY not in adata.obsm:
    print(f"{PCA_KEY} not found. Computing PCA from adata.X.")

    tmp = adata.copy()

    # Use this only if your X is counts. If your X is already processed, adjust as needed.
    sc.pp.normalize_total(tmp, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(tmp)
    sc.pp.pca(tmp, n_comps=50)

    adata.obsm[PCA_KEY] = tmp.obsm[PCA_KEY]

X_pca = np.asarray(adata.obsm[PCA_KEY])

# Guide/target assignments
guide_assignment = get_guide_assignment_df(adata)
guide_target = build_guide_target_table(adata, guide_target_csv=GUIDE_TARGET_CSV)
target_assignment = get_target_assignment_df(guide_assignment, guide_target)

guide_target.to_csv(OUTDIR / "guide_to_target_map.csv", index=False)

if CONTROL_TARGET not in target_assignment.columns:
    raise KeyError(
        f"Could not find {CONTROL_TARGET!r}. Check guide names or combined_TargetKD.csv."
    )

# Cell-level guide/load metrics
targeting_cols = [c for c in target_assignment.columns if c != CONTROL_TARGET]

adata.obs["n_total_guides"] = guide_assignment.sum(axis=1).astype(int).values
adata.obs["n_targeting_targets"] = target_assignment[targeting_cols].sum(axis=1).astype(int).values

# Save carrier counts
carrier_counts = pd.DataFrame({
    "target": target_assignment.columns,
    "n_cells": target_assignment.sum(axis=0).values,
})
carrier_counts.to_csv(OUTDIR / "target_carrier_counts.csv", index=False)

print("Hippo targets present:")
print([t for t in HIPPO_TARGETS if t in target_assignment.columns])

print("Non-targeting cells:")
print(int(target_assignment[CONTROL_TARGET].sum()))
```

## Code cell 109

```python
def get_mode_masks(target):
    """
    Returns:
      seed_mask_base: cells eligible as seed target carriers
      nt_mask_base: cells eligible as non-targeting controls
    """
    target_mask = target_assignment[target].values
    nt_mask = target_assignment[CONTROL_TARGET].values

    n_total_guides = adata.obs["n_total_guides"].values
    n_targeting_targets = adata.obs["n_targeting_targets"].values

    if MODE == "all_carriers":
        seed_mask_base = target_mask
        nt_mask_base = nt_mask & (~target_mask)

    elif MODE == "low_guide_load_leq2":
        low = n_total_guides <= 2
        seed_mask_base = target_mask & low
        nt_mask_base = nt_mask & (~target_mask) & low

    elif MODE == "single_selected_target":
        seed_mask_base = target_mask & (n_targeting_targets == 1)
        nt_mask_base = nt_mask & (~target_mask) & (n_targeting_targets == 0)

    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown MODE: {MODE}")

    return seed_mask_base, nt_mask_base
```

## Code cell 110

```python
def compute_carrier_seeded_pca_knn_enrichment(
    target,
    k=K,
    restrict_neighbors_to_same_day=RESTRICT_NEIGHBORS_TO_SAME_DAY,
    same_day_baseline=SAME_DAY_BASELINE,
    pseudocount=0.5,
):
    """
    For each carrier seed cell of one target:
      1. Find k nearest neighbors in PCA space.
      2. Exclude the seed cell itself.
      3. Count target carriers and NT controls in neighborhood.
      4. Compare local target/NT ratio to same-day/global background ratio.
      5. Compute Fisher p-value and FDR.

    Returns one row per carrier seed cell.
    """
    if target not in target_assignment.columns:
        print(f"[skip] {target}: target not found.")
        return pd.DataFrame()

    seed_mask_base, nt_mask_base = get_mode_masks(target)

    day_vec = adata.obs["day_clean"].astype(str).values
    obs_names = np.asarray(adata.obs_names)

    seed_idx_all = np.where(seed_mask_base)[0]

    if len(seed_idx_all) == 0:
        print(f"[skip] {target}: no seed cells in mode {MODE}.")
        return pd.DataFrame()

    rows = []

    # Build KNN either globally or separately per day
    if restrict_neighbors_to_same_day:
        day_groups = sorted(pd.unique(day_vec[seed_idx_all]))
    else:
        day_groups = ["all"]

    for group in day_groups:
        if restrict_neighbors_to_same_day:
            candidate_mask = day_vec == group
            seed_idx = seed_idx_all[day_vec[seed_idx_all] == group]
        else:
            candidate_mask = np.ones(adata.n_obs, dtype=bool)
            seed_idx = seed_idx_all

        candidate_idx = np.where(candidate_mask)[0]

        if len(candidate_idx) <= 2:
            continue

        X_candidate = X_pca[candidate_idx, :]

        n_neighbors = min(k + 1, len(candidate_idx))

        nbrs = NearestNeighbors(
            n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
            metric="euclidean",
        )

        nbrs.fit(X_candidate)

        # map seed global index to candidate-local index
        global_to_local = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(candidate_idx)}
        seed_local = np.array([global_to_local[s] for s in seed_idx])

        nn_local = nbrs.kneighbors(
            X_candidate[seed_local, :],
            return_distance=False,
        )

        for s_global, neigh_local in zip(seed_idx, nn_local):
            neigh_global = candidate_idx[neigh_local]

            # Exclude the seed itself
            neigh_global = neigh_global[neigh_global != s_global]

            # Keep exactly k if possible
            neigh_global = neigh_global[:k]

            seed_day = day_vec[s_global]

            if same_day_baseline:
                base_mask = day_vec == seed_day
            else:
                base_mask = np.ones(adata.n_obs, dtype=bool)

            # Background counts excluding the seed itself
            target_base_mask = seed_mask_base & base_mask
            nt_base_mask = nt_mask_base & base_mask

            A = int(target_base_mask.sum()) - 1
            B = int(nt_base_mask.sum())

            A = max(A, 0)

            # Local counts excluding seed
            a = int(seed_mask_base[neigh_global].sum())
            b = int(nt_mask_base[neigh_global].sum())

            # Outside-neighborhood counts for Fisher test
            A_out = max(A - a, 0)
            B_out = max(B - b, 0)

            if B == 0 or (a + b) == 0:
                log2fc = np.nan
                fisher_p = np.nan
            else:
                local_ratio = (a + pseudocount) / (b + pseudocount)
                background_ratio = (A + pseudocount) / (B + pseudocount)

                log2fc = np.log2(local_ratio / background_ratio)

                try:
                    fisher_p = fisher_exact(
                        [[a, b], [A_out, B_out]],
                        alternative="two-sided",
                    )[1]
                except Exception:
                    fisher_p = np.nan

            rows.append({
                "target": target,
                "mode": MODE,
                "cell_id": obs_names[s_global],
                "cell_index": int(s_global),
                "day": seed_day,
                "cell_type": adata.obs["cell_type_clean"].iloc[s_global],
                "UMAP1": adata.obs["UMAP1"].iloc[s_global],
                "UMAP2": adata.obs["UMAP2"].iloc[s_global],
                "n_neighbors": len(neigh_global),
                "local_target_n": a,
                "local_nt_n": b,
                "local_other_n": int(len(neigh_global) - a - b),
                "background_target_n": A,
                "background_nt_n": B,
                "log2_enrichment_target_vs_nt": log2fc,
                "fisher_p": fisher_p,
                "restrict_neighbors_to_same_day": restrict_neighbors_to_same_day,
                "same_day_baseline": same_day_baseline,
                "knn_space": PCA_KEY,
            })

    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if len(out):
        # FDR per target/day, because baselines are day-specific
        out["fisher_fdr_by_day"] = np.nan

        for day, idx in out.groupby("day").groups.items():
            out.loc[idx, "fisher_fdr_by_day"] = bh_fdr(out.loc[idx, "fisher_p"].values)

        # Also global FDR across all seed cells for that target
        out["fisher_fdr_global"] = bh_fdr(out["fisher_p"].values)

    return out
```

## Code cell 113

```python
def plot_carrier_seeded_pca_knn_umap(
    scores,
    target,
    outdir=OUTDIR,
    fdr_col="fisher_fdr_by_day",
    fdr_cutoff=FDR_CUTOFF,
    log2fc_clip=LOG2FC_CLIP,
):
    sub = scores[scores["target"].eq(target)].copy()

    if len(sub) == 0:
        print(f"No scores for {target}.")
        return None

    # Background = all cells
    bg = adata.obs[["UMAP1", "UMAP2", "day_clean"]].copy()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.8, 6.2))

    ax.scatter(
        bg["UMAP1"],
        bg["UMAP2"],
        s=BACKGROUND_POINT_SIZE,
        c="lightgrey",
        alpha=BACKGROUND_ALPHA,
        linewidths=0,
        rasterized=True,
    )

    sub["log2_capped"] = sub["log2_enrichment_target_vs_nt"].clip(
        -log2fc_clip,
        log2fc_clip,
    )

    sub["is_sig"] = sub[fdr_col] < fdr_cutoff

    norm = TwoSlopeNorm(
        vmin=-log2fc_clip,
        vcenter=0,
        vmax=log2fc_clip,
    )

    # Non-significant carrier cells: faded
    nonsig = sub[~sub["is_sig"]].copy()

    sc_nonsig = ax.scatter(
        nonsig["UMAP1"],
        nonsig["UMAP2"],
        c=nonsig["log2_capped"],
        cmap="RdBu_r",
        norm=norm,
        s=CARRIER_POINT_SIZE,
        alpha=CARRIER_ALPHA_NONSIG,
        linewidths=0,
        edgecolors="none",
        rasterized=True,
    )

    # Significant carrier cells: same fill scale, stronger alpha.
    sig = sub[sub["is_sig"]].copy()

    sc_sig = ax.scatter(
        sig["UMAP1"],
        sig["UMAP2"],
        c=sig["log2_capped"],
        cmap="RdBu_r",
        norm=norm,
        s=CARRIER_POINT_SIZE,
        alpha=CARRIER_ALPHA_SIG,
        linewidths=0,
        edgecolors="none",
        rasterized=True,
    )

    # Pick one scatter for colorbar
    sc_for_cbar = sc_sig if len(sig) else sc_nonsig

    n_cells = len(sub)
    n_sig = int(sub["is_sig"].sum())
    frac_sig = n_sig / n_cells if n_cells else np.nan
    med = sub["log2_enrichment_target_vs_nt"].median()
    frac_pos = np.mean(sub["log2_enrichment_target_vs_nt"] > 0)

    ax.set_title(
        f"{target} carrier-seeded PCA-kNN enrichment\n"
        f"{MODE}; k={K}; all days pooled | FDR<{fdr_cutoff}: {n_sig}/{n_cells}",
        fontsize=12,
        fontweight="bold",
    )

    ax.text(
        0.02,
        0.02,
        f"median log2FC = {med:.2f}\nfrac positive = {frac_pos:.2f}",
        transform=ax.transAxes,
        ha="left",
        va="bottom",
        fontsize=9,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.25", facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", alpha=0.75),
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("UMAP1")
    ax.set_ylabel("UMAP2")
    ax.set_xticks([])
    ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")

    cbar = fig.colorbar(sc_for_cbar, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.02)
    cbar.set_label("Local enrichment log2FC\nTarget vs NT", fontsize=10)

    fig.tight_layout()

    out_png = outdir / f"carrier_seeded_PCA_kNN_UMAP_{target}_{MODE}.png"
    out_pdf = outdir / f"carrier_seeded_PCA_kNN_UMAP_{target}_{MODE}.pdf"

    fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(out_pdf, bbox_inches="tight")

    plt.show()

    print("Saved:", out_png)

    return fig
```
